ctaBlockTitle: Find these places in Amsterdam on your phone
seoTitle: Finding a toilet, a tap or a shower in Amsterdam
seoText: General map apps are built around businesses and directions, so the free and public things — a toilet in a park, a drinking fountain on a square, a shower at a beach — are the ones they cover least well. That is the gap this map fills. In Amsterdam it currently holds 152 public toilets and 558 places to refill a bottle, each with whatever the source records about cost, opening hours and access. It works the same way in every city you travel to next.
highlight: Amsterdam is a city to carry a bottle in: it has 3.7 times more public drinking water points than public toilets — 558 against 152.
